budget_items.topic: Donation to Turkey Hill Music Department
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A $105 donation from a Lunenburg family was accepted into the gift account.
budget_items.quote: b. donations a donation of $105 from a lunenburg family, this is for the turkey hill music department and will be deposited into the gift account.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Warrants for 3/3/25 to 3/12/25 were signed by the chair.
A transfer for contracted services was made to target the contracted services at the high school level.
budget_items.quote: a transfer for contracted services of $1,374 to target the contracted services at the high school level.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Special ED evaluation line needed more money and was covered from other lines.
budget_items.quote: special ed evaluation line needs $1200.10 so we are using special education general supplies and ace program general supplies and home hospital tutoring account.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The warrant article for a citizen petition would raise and appropriate an amount to supplement the school budget for FY2026, contingent on a Proposition 2 1/2 ballot question; the number was calculated as the difference between the level service budget and the town manager's budget.
budget_items.quote: the language of the warrant article to see if the town will vote to raise and appropriate $2,099,337 to supplement lunenburg public schools budget for fiscal year 2026

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A public commenter said a group of parents filed an override ballot initiative for about $2 million, and urged that the override not be made so large it will not pass.
budget_items.quote: a group of parents did file an override ballot initiative for about $2 million

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A public commenter argued the fifth grade music cut saves very small amounts of money and urged the committee to look at smaller dollar items for free cash.
budget_items.quote: it is very small amounts of money to keep our fifth grade program

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A member said the free cash the committee hoped to use is not guaranteed and the amount keeps going down.
budget_items.quote: my motivation was to hold out for the free cash, but that money is not guaranteed and the amount keeps going down.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The FY26-28 unaffiliated salary schedule has a 4% increase next year and then 2 1/2 % increases for the following two years, mostly for extended day and ELC staff paid primarily from the revolving account.
budget_items.quote: there is a 4% increase next year and then 2 ½ % increases for the following two years.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The FY26 budget will be presented to the Finance Committee again the next day with a few line changes.
budget_items.quote: we will present to the finance committee again tomorrow with a few line changes.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Finance Committee reported that money was given to the school department last year that will not happen again this year.
budget_items.quote: they have stated that last year other departments were not given money and that money was given to the school department that will not happen again this year.
